name: Ravencoin
rootCause: Ravencoin suffered a consensus-level vulnerability in August 2026 that allowed attackers to forge invalid blocks by manipulating the block header, disrupting the network and prompting a coordinated chain recovery and emergency software patch. No direct user balance loss has been established, but the incident triggered a major chain reorganization and significant market impact. Ravencoin’s KAWPOW mining code did not validate that the nHeight field in a block header matched the block’s true position, allowing attackers to bypass the full proof of work and forge blocks. This broke the protocol’s core security assumption and led to multiple invalid blocks being appended to the main chain.
